title: Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers: Replication Package
description: Frozen replication release for the manuscript 'Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers'. The release preserves the scientific master, frozen protocols, executed selector-replication and ALiBi slope-assignment evidence, sensitivity analyses, checkpoint/sample provenance, and SHA-256 manifests. The archive contains mixed scholarly materials under file-specific rights; see LICENSE_SCOPE.md.
